events.evidence: Russian forces shell Sievierodonetsk, Luhansk Oblast, setting ten high-rise buildings on fire
Russia says it will end its invasion if Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy agrees to conditions set during negotiations
Three missiles land near an oil refinery in Erbil, Iraqi Kurdistan

label.note: Conditional Russian offer is mixed; continued shelling and Erbil rocket attack keep risk appetite subdued.
